reading_key: The stressed syllable is in capitals; it is nearly always the first.
j says y: Jord is YORD, Jarf is YARF.
a says ah, e says eh, i says ih, o says oh, u says oo, y says ee; ey says ay (Reyk is RAKE).
Doubled letters are said once: Natt is NAHT.
A final -r after a consonant gets a light vowel: Draugr is DROW-gur, Drattr is DRAHT-ur.
Seams are said as one word: Brakrosh is BRAHK-rosh, not two words.

Gro.intent: Growth: thorns and rot that keep working.

Sol.means: sun, daylight; smites the dark and the undead

Sol.intent: Daylight: smites what hides in the dark.

Natt.intent: Night: shadow that wears the will down.

Aska.means: ash, decay; Natt's child: small damage, a chance to curse
Aska.intent: Ash and decay: small hurt, bad luck after.

Force.means: raw force: bombs and bumps, no affinity reads it

Halv.means: half: the weak, cheap form; every class's basic attack
Halv.note: A kit pick since Nov 21: you have the Halv only if you picked it.
Halv.intent: The small, cheap one: a jab, not a blow.

Mer.note: Replaced Stor- as the second tier.

Jatte.means: giant: two rungs up; found, not carved
Jatte.intent: The giant's version: found, not taught.

Ur.means: primal: the top rung; only on gear
Ur.origin: Swedish and German ur-, primal, first
Ur.intent: The first and oldest: only relics hold it.

Flok.origin: Old Norse flokkr, a band, a troop (Swedish flock)

Mark.means: a spot on the ground: whoever stands there is hit
Mark.note: Reads as English 'mark the spot'. Not the Marked counter.
Mark.intent: Strike the ground, not the body: whoever stands there.

Snar.means: swift: acts a group sooner, a little weaker
Snar.origin: Old Norse snarr, Swedish snar, quick

Tung.intent: Slow and heavy: it lands late and hard.

Bid.means: bide: winds up a round, then lands much harder; lost if broken
Bid.origin: Old Norse bíða, Swedish bida, to wait
Bid.note: English bide is the same word.
Bid.intent: Wind it up, then let it go: huge, if you aren't broken first.

Jarf.means: reckless: weaker, dearer, and crits often and hard
Jarf.origin: Old Norse jarfr, the wolverine (Swedish järv)
Jarf.was: Djarf (bold), dropped: it trips English readers.
Jarf.intent: Reckless as a wolverine: usually less, sometimes devastating.

Drif.means: flurry: small hits that keep coming on a coin flip
Drif.origin: Old Norse drífa, a shower of missiles
Drif.intent: A flurry that keeps coming while luck holds.

Styng.means: adds a hit to a move that does no damage of its own
Styng.origin: coined (Joseph): chosen to evoke English sting
Styng.intent: Put a sting in it: a move that only hinders also hurts.

Lonn.means: adds the move's own rider: a status or a stage
Lonn.origin: Joseph's, from an old search (the second n may be his)
Lonn.note: Shows in a name only where the rider has no word of its own (Lonnpeka); otherwise the rider's word shows (Brakrosh).
Lonn.intent: The move's own extra: the thing it does on top.

Stav.origin: stave, as in the Icelandic galdrastafir, protective magic staves

Hitt.origin: Swedish and Old Norse hitta, to find, to hit

Rask.origin: Old Norse rǫskr, Swedish rask, quick

Eitr.origin: Old Norse eitr, venom (Swedish etter); Ymir was born of it, and Thor dies of it

Nid.origin: Old Norse níð, the scorn-pole níðstǫng (Swedish nid, a lampoon)
Nid.note: Planned to give way to Dokkn as Cursed's word (beinar_pilot).

Ogn.means: terror: fears; planned, also pushes a foe toward weak on an element
Ogn.origin: Old Norse ógn, terror (said OG-n; the game reads OH-gun)
Ogn.note: Ogn is the spell, Feared the status. Ognjord: OH-gun-yord.

Blinda.note: A rider word on Sol (Blindasol); Egga's Blinded is Rod.

Helvad.means: Hel's wager: a chance of death
Helvad.origin: Hel, the death goddess, + Swedish vad, a bet (Swedish hel also means whole: all-in)

Bann.means: the ban: forbidden, a sentence passed; Silences (no MP moves)
Bann.origin: Old Norse and Swedish bann, a ban (Swedish bannlysa, to banish)
Bann.note: A family (Nov 21, Joseph): Bann silences, Bannskott is the shot that silences (Skott's second rider), Bannenlykt the banishing light.
Bann.intent: Forbidden: the sentence passed on a caster.

Lokavad.means: Loki's wager: kill, or die trying
Lokavad.origin: Loki + Swedish vad, a bet; Loki bet his head against Brokkr

Mot.means: against: makes Steadfast; pushes a foe toward resist on an element
Mot.origin: Old Norse mót, Swedish mot, against
Mot.note: No n: Motnjord's 'tnj' is hard in English.

Vingla.means: to totter: leaves the target Reeling
Vingla.note: Not Ving: -ving reads as an English -ing (Snarving, starving).

Blot.origin: coined (Joseph): blood; Blotskott is the bloodshot
Blot.note: A Swede also hears blot, the old blood-sacrifice (Old Norse blót): a fitting echo for a bleeding wound.

Brak.origin: Swedish and Old Norse brak, a crash

Rod.intent: Make them see red: angry, and blind with it.

Sveda.origin: Swedish sveda, to singe (Old Norse svíða)
Sveda.intent: Set it alight and let it burn.

Krosh.means: a blow: the Crush strike; the Vasara's hammer

Spett.means: a skewer: the Pierce strike, with reach

Skott.means: a shot: the bow; reaches anywhere

Hugg.note: Takes Skar's place if Skar doesn't land with players.

Udd.means: a blade's point: pierces through the Front
Udd.origin: Swedish udd, Old Norse oddr, a point

Naglskott.origin: Old Norse nagl, a nail, + skott

Fangskott.means: the trapper's shot: harder on the Pinned
Fangskott.origin: Swedish fånga, to catch (fångst, a catch); English hears fangs
Fangskott.was: Banskott (Old Norse bani, slayer), then Fallskott (one letter from Allskott)
Fangskott.intent: The caught prey: a shot it can't avoid.

Avliva.means: to put down: harder on a foe under half HP
Avliva.origin: Swedish avliva, to put down (what a hunter does for wounded prey)

Skrida.means: to glide: step to a cell, Swift, and Evasive
Skrida.origin: Swedish skrida, Old Norse skríða, to glide (the skiing Finns)
Skrida.intent: Glide away on skis: reposition and be hard to hit.

Egga.origin: Old Norse eggja, to incite (English egg on)

Lya.means: to cover an ally: take their hits

Hevn.means: revenge: harder for every hit taken
Hevn.intent: You hit me; now I hit back, harder for every blow.

Kvad.means: a lay, a song: the Song's stacks heal each round
Kvad.origin: Norwegian and Danish kvad, a poem (Old Norse kvæði)
Kvad.intent: Sing, and keep singing: the song heals every round.

Skolja.means: to rinse: clears statuses and lowered stats

Vakna.means: to wake: brings back the Dying

Knyta.means: to tie: ties a knot of wind for later
Knyta.origin: Swedish knyta, Old Norse knýta, to tie
Knyta.intent: Tie a knot in the wind and keep it for later.

Kuling.means: a gale: spends a knot on wind for everyone
Kuling.origin: Swedish kuling, a gale (the Swedish wind scale)
Kuling.intent: Let one knot go: a gale over everyone.

Orkan.means: a hurricane: spends three knots; wind, then lightning
Orkan.intent: Let all three go: the hurricane, and the lightning after.

Kasta.means: to throw: shoves a foe back a row
Kasta.origin: Old Norse kasta, to throw (English cast)

Svepa.means: to sweep: pulls a foe forward a row

Djupanda.means: a deep breath: a wind-up that brings back MP
Djupanda.intent: A deep breath: stop, and come back full.

Aukskold.intent: Set the shield; hold the line.

Daska.intent: A smack that makes them mad at you.

Genomskott.means: a shot through the leg that Pins (Naglskott + Styng)
Genomskott.intent: A shot through the leg: it hurts and it pins.

Genomskoda.means: to see through: Marked and Sundered (Peka + its rider)
Genomskoda.origin: Swedish genomskåda, to see through someone
Genomskoda.intent: See through their guard, and show everyone the gap.

Gyllenlykt.means: the Golden Lantern: a heal and Evasive 3 (Lak + its rider)
Gyllenlykt.origin: Swedish gyllen, golden, + lykta, lantern; Kajasken's lantern
Gyllenlykt.intent: The golden lantern: mend them, and hide them in its glow.

Geirskott.means: a spear-length shot that pins (Mer Naglskott + Styng)
Geirskott.intent: A spear-length shaft that pins hard.

Tusensplitter.means: a thousand splinters: a bleeding flurry (Mer, Drif, Blot, Skott)

Pilskur.means: an arrow-shower: bleeding arrows on everyone (All, Mer, Blot, Skott)
Pilskur.origin: Swedish pil, arrow, + skur, a shower

Skogsbrand.means: a forest fire (All, Mer, Styng, Lonn Sveda)

Skoldborg.means: shield-fort: DEF up on a row (Flok Aukskold)

Bannenlykt.means: the Banishing Lantern: Marks a foe
Bannenlykt.origin: coined (Joseph): bannen reads as banned, banishing; + Swedish lykta, lantern; Kajasken's lantern

Stynglykt.means: the stinging lantern: a hit and the Mark

Korplykt.means: the Raven Lantern: Marks a row

Allsyn.note: Reads as 'all sin' in English; a short name is needed either way (Allbannenlykt is too long).

Sava.means: to save, to sew: Mending 3 on an ally
Sava.origin: coined (Joseph): a borrowed word, close enough

Besk.means: the bitter tonic: Evasive 3, then the crash
Besk.origin: Swedish besk, bitter; bäsk, herbal bitters

Hasin.means: the hamstring: a heavy pinning, bleeding shot

Genom.note: A soft family: a later spear class might get Genomspett.

Brennumar.origin: Old Norse brennumenn, the burners of the saga house-burnings

Hafrunar.origin: Old Norse haf, the open sea, + rúnar, runes

Skurmar.origin: Old Norse skúr, Swedish skur, a squall

Lundar.origin: Old Norse lundr, Swedish lund, a grove

Dagskald.means: the day-singer: heals with song, smites with daylight

Ullar.origin: Ullr, the god of the bow, skis and the hunt

Nalarbani.means: the needle: a stiletto and a barber-surgeon
Nalarbani.origin: Old Norse nál, needle, + -ar + bani, slayer

Hersir.origin: Old Norse hersir, a district war-leader

Huskarl.origin: Old Norse húskarl, a household warrior

Maekir.origin: Old Norse mækir, a poetic sword

Holmgar.origin: Old Norse hólmganga, the island duel

Atgeir.origin: Old Norse atgeirr, Gunnar's polearm in Njáls saga

Glimar.origin: Old Norse glíma, Norse folk wrestling

Ande.origin: Swedish ande, spirit (Old Norse andi, breath); -ande is also Swedish's -ing

Bein.origin: Old Norse bein, Swedish ben, bone

Drattr.origin: Old Norse dráttr, a haul (of fish)

Djur.origin: Swedish djur, animal (Old Norse dýr; English deer)

Litel.means: little: the annoying small ones (Ande, Mogel)

Drott.origin: Old Norse dróttinn, lord (Swedish drottning, queen)

Forn.means: ancient: the top rank (the undead, the beasts)

Gan.origin: Old Norse gandr, a magic staff or spirit

Poisoned.means: takes damage at the start of each round
Poisoned.intent: The venom works while time passes: they lose HP every round.

Bleeding.means: takes damage when it goes to act
Bleeding.intent: Every move tears the wound: acting costs them HP.

Stunned.means: may lose its next action; clears the first time it costs one
Stunned.intent: Rattled: they may lose their next action, once.

Chilled.means: slowed by cold; a second chill freezes
Chilled.intent: The cold gets in: slower, and one more chill freezes them.

Frozen.means: loses turns; any hit breaks it and shatters
Frozen.intent: Locked in ice: no turns until it breaks, and breaking it hurts.

Bound.intent: Netted: they lose their next action.

Feared.means: acts last; planned: Pinned and DEF down
Feared.intent: Dread: they act late (planned: rooted, and their guard drops).

Disarmed.intent: The weapon is gone: their blows and spells are weaker.

Cursed.means: stages down; planned: Hexed and Poisoned
Cursed.intent: Ill luck sinks in: two of their stats drop.

Silenced.means: can't use anything that costs MP
Silenced.intent: Forbidden: no spells, nothing that costs MP.

Pinned.intent: Nailed to the spot: they can't move or be moved.

Song.means: the Dagskald's verses: heals each round
Song.intent: A verse that keeps healing at the start of each round.

Scorched.means: burning: damage over time, stoked by wind
Scorched.intent: On fire: it burns down over rounds, and wind stokes it.

Dying.means: down at 0 HP, a few breaths left: can be woken

Wounded.means: stabilised after a fall; falling again is death; rest clears it

Dead.means: gone: only the Mead of Waking or the city brings them back

Death.intent: A gamble on their life outright.

Steadfast.means: DEF up, and can't be Pinned or shoved

Mending.means: heals a little at each round's start

Feeble.note: Not Weakened: Weak is an affinity.

Sundered.intent: Their armour is cracked: every blow goes in deeper.

Keen.means: ACC up: your hits crit 1 in 3
Keen.intent: Your eye is sharp: your hits find the crit.

Blinded.means: ACC down: your hits whiff 1 in 3
Blinded.intent: They can't see: their hits miss.

Evasive.means: EVA up: hits on you whiff 1 in 3
Evasive.intent: Hard to hit: attacks on you miss.

Marked.means: EVA down: hits on you crit 1 in 3
Marked.intent: Exposed: every hit on them finds the crit.

Quick.means: SPD up: earlier in the round
Quick.intent: You act sooner in the round.

Slowed.means: SPD down: later in the round
Slowed.intent: They act later in the round.

Swift.means: acts sooner than a normal move

Patient.means: winds up a round before it lands

Weak!.means: x1.5, and a place in the Bonus Round

Super!.means: x2, and a place in the Bonus Round

Immune.means: nothing; never moves on the ladder

Absorb.means: heals the target; never moves on the ladder

Bonus Round.means: an extra round for everyone who hit a weakness

Wind Cord.means: three knots of wind, tied ahead

Shrapnel Bomb.means: bleeding shrapnel on everyone: Allblottskott as an item

Kajasken.means: a god of the far north, keeper of two lanterns
Kajasken.note: His lanterns: Gyllenlykt mends and hides; Bannenlykt reveals and weakens.

part_effects.Snar: Acts a group sooner (Swift), at x1 power for heroes. One step dearer.
part_effects.Tung: Acts late (Heavy), at x1.2 power. One step dearer. Damage and heals.
part_effects.Bid: Winds up a round, then lands at x2.6; lost if the user is broken. One step dearer. Damage and heals.
part_effects.Jarf: x0.7 power, a 25% crit that hits x3. One step dearer. Damage only.
part_effects.Drif: A flurry: hits of x0.5 that keep coming on a coin flip, up to 4. One step dearer. Damage only.
part_effects.Styng: Adds a hit of x0.7 the class's base hit to a move that deals none. One step dearer.
part_effects.Lonn: Adds the move's own rider (a status, or a stage); a hit with a rider lands at x0.6. One step dearer.
part_effects.Auk: Raises the stat its word names.
part_effects.Ned: Lowers the stat its word names.
